sql:
CREATE TABLE assets(
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, original_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, filename TEXT NOT NULL,
                    extension TEXT NOT NULL, filesize INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(filesize>=0), checksum TEXT NOT NULL,
                    capture_date INTEGER, import_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    width INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(width>0), height INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(height>0),
                    orientation INTEGER NOT NULL, camera TEXT, lens TEXT, focal_length REAL,
                    aperture REAL, shutter_seconds REAL, iso REAL, gps_latitude REAL, gps_longitude REAL,
                    rating INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(rating BETWEEN 0 AND 5),
                    flag INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(flag IN (-1,0,1)), color_label TEXT)

CREATE TABLE collection_assets(collection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,PRIMARY KEY(collection_id,asset_id))

CREATE TABLE collections(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
                    CHECK(length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE edit_curve_points(
                    asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    channel INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(channel BETWEEN 0 AND 3),
                    position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position BETWEEN 0 AND 31),
                    x REAL NOT NULL CHECK(x BETWEEN 0 AND 1), y REAL NOT NULL CHECK(y BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
                    PRIMARY KEY(asset_id,channel,position))

CREATE TABLE "edit_documents"(
                    asset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8 CHECK(schema_version=8),
                    exposure REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(exposure BETWEEN -5 AND 5),
                    temperature REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 6500 CHECK(temperature BETWEEN 2000 AND 25000),
                    tint REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(tint BETWEEN -150 AND 150),
                    custom_wb INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(custom_wb IN (0,1)),
                    contrast REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(contrast BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    highlights REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(highlights BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    shadows REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(shadows BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    whites REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(whites BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    blacks REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(blacks BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    vibrance REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(vibrance BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    saturation REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(saturation BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 98303 CHECK(typeof(enabled)='integer' AND enabled BETWEEN 0 AND 131071),
                    curve_shadows REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(curve_shadows BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    curve_darks REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(curve_darks BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    curve_lights REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(curve_lights BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    curve_highlights REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(curve_highlights BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    advanced_saved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(advanced_saved IN (0,1)),
                    sharpen_amount REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(sharpen_amount BETWEEN 0 AND 150),
                    sharpen_radius REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(sharpen_radius BETWEEN 0.5 AND 3),
                    sharpen_detail REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 25 CHECK(sharpen_detail BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
                    sharpen_masking REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(sharpen_masking BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
                    noise_luminance REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(noise_luminance BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
                    noise_luminance_detail REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(noise_luminance_detail BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
                    noise_luminance_contrast REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(noise_luminance_contrast BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
                    noise_color REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(noise_color BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
                    noise_color_detail REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(noise_color_detail BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
                    noise_color_smoothness REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 50 CHECK(noise_color_smoothness BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
                    crop_x REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(crop_x>=0),
                    crop_y REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(crop_y>=0),
                    crop_width REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(crop_width>=0.00005 AND crop_x+crop_width<=1.000000000001),
                    crop_height REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(crop_height>=0.00005 AND crop_y+crop_height<=1.000000000001),
                    crop_angle REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(crop_angle BETWEEN -45 AND 45),
                    crop_aspect REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(crop_aspect IN (-1,0) OR crop_aspect BETWEEN 0.01 AND 100),
                    crop_quarter_turns INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(typeof(crop_quarter_turns)='integer' AND crop_quarter_turns BETWEEN 0 AND 3),
                    crop_flip_h INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(crop_flip_h IN (0,1)),
                    crop_flip_v INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(crop_flip_v IN (0,1)),
                    lens_profile TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(typeof(lens_profile)='text' AND (lens_profile='' OR (length(lens_profile)=32 AND lens_profile NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'))),
                    lens_distortion REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 100 CHECK(lens_distortion BETWEEN 0 AND 200),
                    lens_vignetting REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 100 CHECK(lens_vignetting BETWEEN 0 AND 200),
                    lens_ca INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(lens_ca IN (0,1)),
                    transform_rotate REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_rotate BETWEEN -45 AND 45),
                    transform_horizontal REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_horizontal BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    transform_vertical REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_vertical BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    transform_aspect REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_aspect BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    transform_scale REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 100 CHECK(transform_scale BETWEEN 50 AND 200),
                    transform_x_offset REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_x_offset BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    transform_y_offset REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_y_offset BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    transform_constrain_crop INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(transform_constrain_crop IN (0,1)),
                    transform_guided INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_guided IN (0,1)),
                    transform_m11 REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(transform_m11 BETWEEN -32 AND 32),
                    transform_m12 REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_m12 BETWEEN -32 AND 32),
                    transform_m13 REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_m13 BETWEEN -32 AND 32),
                    transform_m21 REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_m21 BETWEEN -32 AND 32),
                    transform_m22 REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(transform_m22 BETWEEN -32 AND 32),
                    transform_m23 REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_m23 BETWEEN -32 AND 32),
                    transform_m31 REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_m31 BETWEEN -32 AND 32),
                    transform_m32 REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(transform_m32 BETWEEN -32 AND 32),
                    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE edit_hsl_bands(
                    asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    band INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(band BETWEEN 0 AND 7),
                    hue REAL NOT NULL CHECK(hue BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    saturation REAL NOT NULL CHECK(saturation BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    luminance REAL NOT NULL CHECK(luminance BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
                    PRIMARY KEY(asset_id,band))

CREATE TABLE edit_local_masks(
            asset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES edit_documents(asset_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            document TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(document)='text' AND length(CAST(document AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576))

CREATE TABLE import_items(session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_sessions(id),
                    position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position>=0),source_path TEXT NOT NULL,target_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    temporary_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',checksum TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',filesize INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','staged','committed','duplicate','failed','cancelled')),
                    asset_id TEXT REFERENCES assets(id),error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',PRIMARY KEY(session_id,position))

CREATE TABLE import_sessions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('add','copy')),
                    destination TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('running','completed','cancelled','interrupted')),
                    owner_pid INTEGER NOT NULL,skip_duplicates INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(skip_duplicates IN (0,1)),created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    finished_at TEXT)
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations(version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
CREATE TABLE session(slot INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(slot=1), asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id))
CREATE INDEX assets_filename ON assets(filename COLLATE NOCASE,id)
